periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 to 60 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovals where the height-to-width ratio is significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering effect, with the lower extremity of the patch narrowing toward the snout.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap across the superior cranial region, showing a distinct white separation between the black pinnae.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semi-rounded curvature with slight tapering at the superior-most points, creating a subtly triangular rather than perfectly semicircular profile.

other_distinctive_markers: The white fur on the cranium and upper torso displays a distinct pinkish-tan chromatic hue.
